claims.text: Sandbox 開啟後，指令只能寫入專案資料夾等少數位置
claims.note: Defaults: working directory, per-user temp dir, added dirs.

claims.text: 對外連線經過代理，只有允許清單上的網域才連得到
claims.note: Proxy checks each host against allowed domains, which start empty.

claims.text: macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap 實作
sandbox 裡的指令可以不必每次都問你
claims.note: Auto-allow mode approves sandboxed commands without a prompt; some exceptions still prompt.

claims.text: prompt injection 可能誘導 agent 做出危險動作
claims.note: Permission-modes page warns bypass mode offers no protection against prompt injection; sandbox page itself speaks of a compromised agent.

claims.text: 完全不問就放行時，官方建議只在隔離的容器或虛擬機裡使用
claims.note: bypassPermissions: isolated containers and VMs only.
